=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:65-84 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The anchored `editor failed` filter still drops legitimate audit bullets that merely contain that phrase, which can make a healthy audit look empty/fallback.
  WHY: Four reviewers reported false-positive stripping and downstream `EDITOR_NOOP_SUSPICIOUS` stalls; one reviewer disputed the bug as fixed, but the reported regression is the same filter behavior.
- tests/test_validate_editor_audit.py:40-320 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new helper tests that rely on temporary directories cannot create usable temp paths in this sandbox, so most of the test file never runs.
  WHY: Two reviewers reproduced `FileNotFoundError` from `TemporaryDirectory`/`tmp_path`; one reviewer noted this is environment-specific rather than a code change.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py:318-340 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The standalone runner in this file also depends on temporary-directory creation and fails in the current sandbox.
  WHY: Two reviewers reported the same `FileNotFoundError` class of failure for the contract test runner.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:957 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new audit-helper contract tests are not wired into the CI/test-and-mark-stable allowlists, so they will not run in automation.
  WHY: Two reviewers said the helper was added to bootstrap/sourcing, but the matching tests are missing from workflow allowlists and can drift undetected.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:98-130 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The field-extraction regexes can partially match malformed audit lines and capture the wrong digits.
  WHY: A malformed line with multiple numeric substrings can make the parser extract the wrong count and produce an incorrect validation result.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:119-123 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The arithmetic consistency check is skipped when `total` is 0, so a zero-total line with non-zero summed counts can pass.
  WHY: The `[ "${t}" -gt 0 ]` guard prevents the mismatch check from running on zero-total entries.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:59-63 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Temp-file creation is not validated before use.
  WHY: If `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}` is missing or unwritable, `mktemp` can fail and the caller sees a confusing downstream Gate B failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- tests/test_validate_editor_audit.py:43-296 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: All tests using the tmp_path fixture fail with `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found in ['/tmp', '/var/tmp', '/usr/tmp', '/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows']`.
  WHY: The test runner uses `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()` in main(), but the sandbox environment rejects temp directory creation, making 14 of 15 tests unreachable.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py:318-340 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Same tmp_path issue affects this file - it uses the same standalone runner pattern with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory().
  WHY: Contract tests for the noop-suspicious recovery sweep cannot run in this environment.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml, test-and-mark-stable.yml, mark-stable.yml:n/a | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The two new test files (`tests/test_validate_editor_audit.py` and `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py`) are not referenced in any workflow test allowlist.
  WHY: While the helper script `validate_editor_audit.sh` IS correctly added to REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS in review_autofix.yml (line 957), the contract tests that verify the helper's behavior will never run in CI.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:69-84 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The anchored fallback filter strips legitimate audit bullets containing the phrase "editor failed" anywhere in the line, not just the fallback bullet shape. (2 related items)
  WHY: Valid filenames like `review editor failed case.md` are treated as fallback, causing the audit section to appear empty and reintroducing false-positive `EDITOR_NOOP_SUSPICIOUS` stalls.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:98-130 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The bash regex patterns don't anchor to word boundaries, so malformed audit lines with embedded numbers could be partially matched.
  WHY: A corrupted audit line can capture the wrong digit for the total count, causing the arithmetic check to incorrectly pass or fail.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:119-123 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The code checks `[ "${t}" -gt 0 ]` before comparing sum to total, but if total is 0 and the line is malformed (sum ≠ 0), the mismatch is silently skipped.
  WHY: A zero-total audit entry with non-zero applied counts can pass validation because the `t > 0` guard prevents the check from running.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:69-71 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The anchored `editor failed` filter can still remove legitimate audit bullets whose filenames or prose contain the substring "editor failed".
  WHY: An audit line like `- review editor failed case.md: total issues listed 1, issues applied 1, issues already applied 0, issues ignored 0` can be filtered out as fallback text, causing a false `EDITOR_NOOP_SUSPICIOUS` trigger.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:59-63 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The temp file path generation uses `mktemp` without validation that the directory exists and is writable.
  WHY: If `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}` points to a non-existent or read-only directory, `mktemp` fails and the subsequent code emits a confusing Gate B failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:65-76 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The anchored `editor failed` filter can remove legitimate audit bullets whose filenames or prose contain the phrase, and the surrounding audit extraction then treats the section as fallback/empty.
  WHY: A healthy audit line such as `- review editor failed case.md: total issues listed 1, issues applied 1, issues already applied 0, issues ignored 0` can be stripped, making the workflow think the PR is still in the noop-suspicious state. (2 related items)
- tests/test_validate_editor_audit.py:~40-50, ~53-320 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Every test that calls `_run(...)` or relies on `tmp_path` fails with `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found in ['/tmp', '/var/tmp', '/usr/tmp', '/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows']`.
  WHY: The test runner cannot create the summary file the bash helper needs, so the new helper tests are unreachable in this environment.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (lines ~957) and scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The helper is listed in `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS`, but none of the new test files are wired into any CI/test-and-mark-stable workflow allowlist.
  WHY: Bootstrap succeeds while the contract tests that are supposed to guard against drift never execute, so future helper regressions go undetected.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
